meta.title: TriadicFrameworks — Complete Module Graph (15 Schemas)
meta.description: Consolidated dependency graph stitching 15 canonical RTT module schemas — the universal web root (webroot) as the single root parent, containing TFT_3Pack_v1.3 (13 child module schemas) and the Governance Substrate Model (GSM). Includes hierarchy edges, import/export mappings, cross-references, circular dependency detection, and aggregate analytics.

tft-3pack.name: TFT 3Pack
tft-3pack.purpose: Compact, example-driven toolkit demonstrating the TriadicFrameworks model across 12 academic domains via shell scripts, .fff resonance files, and a dark-themed documentation system.

wrsadc.name: WRSADC
wrsadc.purpose: Lightweight resonance-aware dimensional engine providing state tracking, entity observation, structural snapshots, and triadic introspection for TFT_3Pack_v1.3 tools.

tft-core.name: TFT Core
tft-core.purpose: Core lattice of the 3Pack — CLI entrypoint, output management, and orchestration hub binding four child modules (tops, resonance-labs, nous, entft) into a unified triadic runtime.

tops.name: TOPS
tops.purpose: Triconceptual simulation engine exploring perception through direct, reflective, and inversion modes with resonance clarity (--basetype lens switching). Orchestrates agents, AI pipelines, overlays, folds, and hardware targets as a unified operator system.

session_summary.drift: medium (remix lineage tracking, echo/drift agents, legacy archives)
session_summary.format: python + shell + markdown + yaml + json + csv + svg + png + pdf

entft.name: ENTFT
entft.purpose: Quantum-hostile encryption and entanglement layer — divide-by-zero obfuscation, triadic resonance security, ternary-grade modularity for hooks, validators, scroll rituals, and glyph lifecycle governance.

structural_grammar.regime_envelope: R1–R3 (elevated: encryption adds regime R3 for key management and access control)

session_summary.drift: high (87 scrolls tracking glyph lifecycle: fusion, retirement, reawakening, echo, lineage)
session_summary.format: python + markdown + json + yaml + svg + cfg + log

nous.name: Nous
nous.purpose: Symbolic cognition layer encoding TFT core logic — triadic, ternary, and symbolic. Provides the conceptual backbone for simulations via 12-domain bot fleet, logic shells, resonance tooling, and runtime modules.

session_summary.drift: medium (remix lineage, fold remixing, echo archival across bots)
session_summary.coherence: stable (12-bot fleet + 7-tool resonance suite + test coverage)

resonance-labs.name: Resonance Labs
resonance-labs.purpose: Experimental wing of the 3Pack — harmonic overlays, observer states, mirror geometry, temporal simulation, and symbolic glyph rendering. Where mythic experimentation meets technical rigor.

examples.name: Examples
examples.purpose: 20-domain resonance-aware example curriculum — 12 original academic subject suites (problems, solutions, extended problems, resonance flows) plus 11 expansion RTT domain documents covering earth sciences through security and resilience.

formats.name: Formats
formats.purpose: Canonical .fff (TriadicFrameworks Format File) specification defining resonant-time values, triadic operators, frequency elevation, temperature coupling, and composite constants. Provides three graded template files and a full format spec.

session_summary.coherence: stable (INI-style [TFT] section structure with required/optional fields)

melodic-table.name: Melodic Table of Elements
melodic-table.purpose: Interactive sonified periodic table — maps chemical element properties (period, group, block) to musical tones via triadic harmonic synthesis. Fork of leonard-seydoux's project, adapted into the TriadicFrameworks resonance ecosystem.

mve.name: Molecular Vibration Explorer
mve.purpose: Interactive DFT-powered molecular vibrational spectra explorer — tensorial light-vibration coupling, IR/Raman/SFG analysis, orientation-dependent spectroscopy, and molecular similarity search across Gold (2800 thiols) and Thiol (1900 compounds) databases. Fork of zskb/molecular-vibration-explorer, adapted into the TriadicFrameworks resonance ecosystem.

structural_grammar.dimensional_envelope: D3–D6 (3D molecular geometry × tensor polarization × frequency spectra)

session_summary.drift: minimal (stable DFT database, fixed computational methods)
session_summary.coherence: stable (Jupyter notebook pipeline + Voilà web app contract)
session_summary.format: python + jupyter notebook + voilà + data files

gsm.name: Governance Substrate Model
gsm.purpose: Structurally aligned reference framework for designing, evaluating, and stewarding governance systems across cultures, regimes, and time horizons. Encodes ten governance layers (Invariants through Adapters) plus a full Analyzer engine that maps systems into a five-axis structural space [C,M,O,A,T], checks alignment against invariants, computes drift vectors, and determines equilibrium basin membership. Behavior-first, non-ideological, substrate-agnostic — designed to remain legible hundreds of years forward.

structural_grammar.dimensional_envelope: D3–D9 (triadic governance geometry × regime modes × time horizons)
structural_grammar.regime_envelope: R1–R3 (multi-regime governance design — R3 for cross-regime stress testing and adapter mapping)
structural_grammar.coherence_envelope: C1–C3 (invariant compliance → layer consistency → cross-adapter coherence)

session_summary.coherence: stable (10-layer governance hierarchy + 5-axis structural vector space)

scripts.name: Scripts
scripts.purpose: Executable shell script toolkit for running, validating, converting, and batch-processing .fff resonance files. Includes overlay scripts for triadic logic, encryption, and grid operations. Intentionally lightweight and transparent so students can inspect how resonance-time, triadic operators, and TFT constants are processed.

structural_grammar.dimensional_envelope: D3–D9 (scripts operate across full dimensional range via .fff input)
structural_grammar.coherence_envelope: C1 (strict input/output contract: .fff in → text out)

docs.name: Docs
docs.purpose: Canonical scrolls, specifications, rituals, and metadata for the TFT 3Pack. Defines symbolic structure (.fff spec, output logic, test suite), preserves glyph lifecycle metadata (registries, retirement logs, echo logs, reawakening traces), codifies contributor rituals (codex forks, tribute flames, fusion ceremonies), and houses protocol specifications (Nawderian theorem, ENTFT keygen, protocol manifests).

structural_grammar.regime_envelope: R1–R2 (R2: glyph lifecycle governance adds regime-level tracking)
structural_grammar.coherence_envelope: C1–C3 (spec compliance → ritual consistency → cross-registry coherence)

session_summary.format: markdown + json + yaml + python + svg + html

webroot.name: TriadicFrameworks Web Root
webroot.purpose: Universal root of the TriadicFrameworks ecosystem — the canonical, navigation-first entry point rendered directly as the project website (triadicframeworks.org). Defines the site-wide structural grammar through 13 common scrolls covering identity, principles, ethics, lineage, security, contribution, licensing, and orientation. Parent to all child modules. Designed as an AI-ready substrate — every page stands alone, every module is machine-parsable, and the repo is the single source of truth.

structural_grammar.regime_envelope: R1–R3 (full regime range — child modules select within this envelope)
structural_grammar.regime_sensitivity: high (root defines regime awareness as a structural duty)

session_summary.drift: minimal (root-locked — structural grammar is invariant by design)
session_summary.coherence: stable (triadic-structural grammar — the grammar that all child modules inherit)
